title: Pure Evil Eye
summary: Pure Evil Eye control build with generic Fiend Links and staples. Evil Eye of Selene is the heart of the deck: equipped to an Evil Eye monster, it makes that monster untargetable and indestructible by battle and card effects while unlocking Quick Effect disruption across your Evil Eye monsters, Spells, and Traps.

summary.title: Starters
points: Serziel, Watcher of the Evil Eye searches any Evil Eye card from the Deck on Normal Summon.

Evil Eye Domain - Pareidolia searches an Evil Eye monster on activation, while Evil Eyes Unleashed sends an Evil Eye monster and an Evil Eye Spell/Trap from the Deck to the GY to search an Evil Eye Equip Spell.
Basilius, Familiar of the Evil Eye Special Summons itself while you control an Evil Eye monster and sends an Evil Eye Spell/Trap from the Deck to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Serziel + Evil Eyes Unleashed
steps: Activate Evil Eyes Unleashed, sending Basilius, Familiar of the Evil Eye and Evil Eye of Gorgoneio from the Deck to the GY to add Evil Eye of Selene to your hand.
Banish Evil Eye of Gorgoneio from the GY and discard a card to search an Evil Eye Spell/Trap (such as Evil Eye Retribution or Evil Eye Defeat).

Normal Summon Serziel, Watcher of the Evil Eye to search Basiltrice, Familiar of the Evil Eye (or Evil Eye Awakening), then equip Evil Eye of Selene to Serziel (or save Selene in hand to equip to Zerrziel after Link climbing via Evil Eyes Unleashed's GY effect).

Keep Serziel equipped with Selene to destroy a Special Summoned monster and negate a Spell/Trap with Retribution, or use Basiltrice on the opponent's turn to Link Summon Gorgon, Empress of the Evil Eyed or Zerrziel, Ruler of the Evil Eyed using Evil Eye Equip Spells you control as Fiend Link Materials.

summary.title: Evil Eye of Selene & Gorgoneio
summary.text: Every time you activate an Evil Eye card or effect (or your equipped monster destroys a monster by battle), Evil Eye of Selene grants the equipped monster 500 ATK and costs 500 LP, and if Selene is in the GY you can pay 1000 LP and banish an Evil Eye Spell/Trap from the GY to Set it back. Evil Eye of Gorgoneio's name becomes Evil Eye of Selene while on the field, turning your LP deficit into an ATK boost for the equipped monster while banishing itself from the GY to search any Evil Eye Spell/Trap.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Zerrziel, Ruler of the Evil Eyed (Link-3) and Serziel, Watcher of the Evil Eye each gain a Quick Effect while equipped with Evil Eye of Selene to target and destroy an opponent's card (or Special Summoned monster), then destroy 1 card you control during the next Standby Phase.
Gorgon, Empress of the Evil Eyed (Link-2) gains a Quick Effect while equipped with Selene to negate the effects of an opponent's Effect Monster until the end of the turn.
Medusa, Watcher of the Evil Eye recovers an Evil Eye card from the GY on Normal Summon and banishes a monster from the opponent's GY as a Quick Effect while equipped with Selene.
Note: Evil Eye Reemergence locks you into Fiend Special Summons for the rest of the turn, which A Bao A Qu, the Lightless Shadow, Beat Cop from the Underworld, and Dispatchparazzi all respect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Evil Eye Awakening Special Summons an Evil Eye from the hand or GY—or straight from the Deck if Evil Eye of Selene is in your Spell & Trap Zone.

Evil Eye Retribution negates a Spell/Trap activation (and cannot be negated itself if Selene is on the field), Evil Eye Defeat bounces 1 monster (or 2 if Selene is out), and Evil Eye Mesmerism steals control of an opponent's Special Summoned monster with lower ATK.
Evil Eye Confrontation destroys an opponent's Spell/Trap (and banishes it if Selene is out), while Evil Eye Repose draws a card and banishes monsters that battle your Selene-equipped monster.
